visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up view of a slice of durian crepe cake served on a textured black ceramic plate. The cake shows distinct, thin layers of light yellow crepe and creamy filling. A metal fork is shown pressing down and slicing into the soft layers, revealing a thick, moist durian paste center. In the background, other cakes like a taro crepe and a matcha cake are visible in a softly lit cafe setting. (2) This phase shows the production environment with bright, neutral lighting. A person wearing sterile blue latex gloves is preparing the cakes. They pour a pale yellow batter from a measuring cup into a flat, circular black pan. The scene cuts to the person carefully peeling off a thin, cooked crepe layer and stacking it onto a tall, layered cake base on a rotating metal stand. They use a flat metal offset spatula to spread a smooth layer of greyish-purple cream across the top of the stack. (3) Returning to the finished product, the camera focuses tightly on the durian crepe cake. A gold-toned fork lifts a generous bite-sized piece of the cake, emphasizing the structural integrity of the layers and the gooey, rich texture of the durian fruit filling. A small white paper brand tag is pinned to the top of the slice. The background remains blurred, suggesting a cozy, indoor dining environment with natural-looking artificial light. (4) A rapid montage showcasing multiple flavors of crepe cakes. First, a purple taro crepe cake is sliced into, followed by a vibrant green matcha crepe cake topped with a dried orange slice. Then, a cocoa-dusted tiramisu crepe cake with ladyfingers embedded inside is shown, and finally, a creamy sea salt pistachio cake topped with crushed nuts. Each shot features a fork interacting with the cake to show its soft, layered texture against clean white or black plates. (5) The visual shifts to different product offerings. A person’s hands hold an open white cardboard box containing twelve different slices of crepe cake arranged in a circle, creating a multicolored sampler cake. Then, a close-up of a golden-brown, soft-centered Basque cheesecake is shown, followed by a matcha Mont Blanc cake with intricate green cream piping being cut by a fork. The setting is a professional-looking counter area with refrigerated display cases in the background. (6) The final phase displays the shop's physical environment. It starts with a wide shot of the interior featuring a long glass display case filled with various cakes and desserts under warm, modern pendant lighting. The scene then transitions to an outdoor view of the shop’s exterior. The storefront is clean and white with large glass windows and a prominent white sign with Felicicake and Chinese characters. The sky is clear and bright, indicating a sunny day.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional showcase for a crepe cake specialty shop named 甜裡找茶 (Tian Li Zhao Cha). It aims to entice dessert lovers by highlighting the high-quality durian crepe cake and a variety of other flavors such as taro, matcha, and pistachio. By showing the meticulous hand-making process and the appetizing textures of the cakes, the content seeks to drive customers to pre-order and visit their Kaohsiung location.
